expected_level_description: You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements
You can: - plan and run the information governance assurance programme - judge whether evidence meets the standard and identify gaps - work with internal and external auditors

You can: - review and advise on data protection impact assessments for complex systems - judge whether risks are acceptable and recommend controls - decide when to escalate high risks for senior or regulator review
You can: - investigate serious incidents and find their root causes - decide, with senior colleagues, whether to notify regulators and people affected - share lessons and track improvements
You can: - apply the retention schedule to records and flag those due for review - prepare records for archiving or secure destruction, and keep the audit trail
You can: - record and update risks for your area - suggest controls and track actions
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession

You can: - work with stakeholders to identify and address ethical and privacy concerns - demonstrate and communicate how data ethical issues fit into the wider organisational context - research developments in data ethics and privacy to improve compliance and processes - assess and constructively challenge proposed data ethics policies

You can: - work with the team to develop and maintain an understanding of stakeholders - work with the team to develop and implement stakeholder communications strategies - identify and resolve issues, influence stakeholders and manage relationships effectively - build long-term strategic relationships and communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders
